analyst.summary: Shriram Pistons & Rings has rebranded itself SPR Auto Technologies and is funding a real diversification into electronics, lighting and EV components, on the back of its highest-ever annual results. Management itself has flagged that EVs could reach 15-17% of the market by 2030 -- a direct risk to its traditional piston/rings business -- and is investing ahead of it. Growth has been strong recently, though profit didn't quite keep pace with revenue this past year. We rate it a Hold: a legacy auto-parts maker taking real, funded steps to diversify, priced accordingly rather than cheaply.
